scoring_justification: The paper reports exact numerical values for TOECs and derivatives; the agent computes them from digitised data; we compare submitted values against the reported gold within tolerances.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold target values for TOECs and temperature/pressure derivatives
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 3 (TOECs) and Table 4 (derivatives and Grüneisen parameters) of the source paper (Materials Chemistry and Physics 74 (2002) 160‑166)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Directly transcribed from the paper’s published tables
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the exact published experimental values the paper claims; they serve as the authoritative reference for reproduction.

outputs.description: The nine third-order elastic constants derived from pressure‑dependent ultrasonic data.
The six quantities that summarize the temperature and pressure response of the elastic moduli and the acoustic mode Grüneisen parameters.

output_contract.notes: All input velocity and pressure data are bundled digital extractions from the source paper. The agent is expected to reproduce the computational pipeline (velocity‑to‑modulus conversion, linear fitting, Thurston–Brugger equation solving, and Grüneisen formulas) and report the derived constants. The hidden checker recomputes the same quantities from the same input data and compares within appropriate tolerances.

steps.description: Third‑order elastic constants must match gold values within tolerance.
Temperature and pressure derivatives and Grüneisen parameters must match gold values within tolerance.
